title: Fixed-arity operation spaces of the groupoid string-to-pair map
statement:
Use the universe, space and infinity-category conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], the coherent nerves and string/operator categories of [lem-coef-simplicial-operator-nerve], and the multicategory $O_G$ and functor $\Phi_G$ with their explicit formulas of [lem-coef-operad-groupoid-operator-map]. Let $G$ be any small fibrant simplicial groupoid and set $X=N_{\mathrm{hc}}G$, $M=N_{\mathrm{hc}}D(G)$, $O=N_{\mathrm{hc}}O_G^\otimes$ and $f=N_{\mathrm{hc}}\Phi_G$. For objects $x,y$ of $G$ and $n\geq0$, let $\operatorname{Op}_{M,n}(x,y)$ be the space of active arrows from objects of $M_{[n]}$ to $(x,y)\in M_{[1]}$, with coherent triangles whose source-change edges are equivalences over the identity of $[n]$, retaining all higher simplices. Define $\operatorname{Op}_{O,n}(x,y)$ in the same manner. These are the arity-$n$ parts of the operation spaces in [lem-coef-operadic-localization-operation-criterion].

Let $A_x$ be the space of arrows of $X$ starting at $x$, allowing the final endpoint to vary, and $B_y$ the space of arrows ending at $y$, allowing the initial endpoint to vary; morphisms and higher simplices are coherent triangles and homotopies with the specified endpoint fixed. For every $n\geq1$ there are equivalences of spaces
$$\operatorname{Op}_{M,n}(x,y)\simeq A_x\times X^{n-1}\times B_y,\qquad
\operatorname{Op}_{O,n}(x,y)\simeq A_x\times\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,X)^{n-1}\times B_y.$$
They identify the map induced by $f$ with the identity on $A_x,B_y$ and the constant-path map on every internal factor. The endpoint convention on the first factor for $M$ is changed by inversion. Thus this induced map is an equivalence for every $n\geq1$.

For $n=0$, both operation spaces are equivalent to $\operatorname{Map}_X(x,y)$ and $f$ induces an equivalence. Under these identifications a source object $(z,a:z\to x,b:z\to y)$ on the $M$ side maps to $ba^{-1}$; an inverse on the path-space description sends $h:x\to y$ to $(x,1_x,h)$. All assertions are about the full coherent operation spaces, not only components, and use only identity-arity source changes.
